verdict.rationale: Sentry has its own CLI for release and source-map management and a web API for programmatic access, both suited to non-interactive automation. Its directory also lists a Bitbucket Pipelines integration that notifies Sentry of CI builds. However, the evidence never explicitly documents running headlessly in CI pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless usage docs (e.g. token-based non-interactive auth, CI pipeline guides), broader CI provider coverage beyond Bitbucket Pipelines, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: It’s primarily used for managing debug information files for iOS, Android, release and source maps management, as well as code mappings for other platforms.
Deploy notifications and source map uploads.
Automatically notify Sentry of new Bitbucket Pipelines builds.
The Sentry web API is used to access the Sentry platform programmatically.
